name: Smoke
text: A zone becomes Dark until the end of next round.

name: Grapple
text: Move to any zone you can see, including High Ground.

name: Flashbang
text: Roll Flow against the Guard of everyone in a zone. Everyone you beat has Disadvantage on their next roll.

name: Taser
text: A Jab. On a hit, the target loses their next Quick Action.

name: Tracker
text: Tag someone. If they get away, take 1 clue about where they went.

name: Armor
text: Toughness 1 against guns for the Night.
